page.name: commission_access

div.class: rounded border bg-light p-4 mb-4 mt-3

div.p: Choose a role, define the management scope, and review accounting eligibility.

group.div: Assigned regions include their subregions and branch teams. Each team has one commission manager; assigning an existing team transfers that scope to this user.

page.div: No access to Commission Studio. Existing sales and accounting permissions remain separate.
This salesperson can view only their own commission entries, dashboard and contribution to their team target.
This manager can view their own commissions and all commission entries of the assigned regions and descendant teams. Other regions remain inaccessible.
No managed regions are assigned. This manager currently sees only their own commissions.
This administrator can configure commission rules and targets and view commissions across their allowed companies. Region assignments do not limit this administrator role.

group.div: Historical accrual booking requires both Commission Administrator and Accounting Administrator. Assign accounting access separately in Access Rights. This tab does not grant accounting permissions.

page.div: Scope applies to the dashboard, ledger, reports and exports. Allowed companies are still controlled in Access Rights. Management assignments are retained when a role is removed, but do not grant regional access without the Region manager role.
